title: tl-orchestrator runtime config
description: Consumer-owned configuration for scripts/tl_runtime.py. It names harness adapters, roles, deterministic gates, limits and the policy inputs the runtime enforces. It grants no authority: effects come from the frozen batch's permitted_effects.

argv.description: Command line for one dispatch. Placeholders: {pack_path}, {pack_text}, {result_path}, {model}, {effort}, {tools}, {role}. Must reference {pack_path} or {pack_text}.

family.description: Model family used for the Maker/Checker independence rule; defaults to the adapter name.

capabilities.description: Declared, not inferred. A capability set to false is reported as a limitation in the morning report.

allow_same_family_review.description: Only for offline fixtures. In real use the Checker must come from another family.

accept_unisolated_worker.description: Required to run an adapter that declares neither tools_allowlist nor network_sandbox. The runtime refuses otherwise, so the lack of isolation is a conscious choice.

by_flag.description: Extra gates activated by the unit's frontmatter flags (ui, migration, security, ...).

canonical.description: Full gate run at CLOSE when every unit completed.

loop_threshold.description: Same failure signature this many times parks the unit; a model switch does not reset it.

stagnation_rounds.description: Identical Checker findings for this many consecutive rounds parks the unit.

max_cost_usd.description: Enforced only over calls whose adapter reported cost; otherwise reported as unenforceable.

base_branch.description: Integration branch; defaults to the branch checked out when the batch opens.

tasks_dir.description: Where a work_ref like T042 resolves to T042*.md when it is not a path.

sensitive_paths.description: Touching any of these stops the batch (external_effect_not_authorized).

env_allowlist.description: Extra environment variable names passed to workers and gates, on top of the built-in base allowlist.

prompts_dir.description: Directory holding maker.md / checker-report-only.md; defaults to the package prompts.

notify_argv.description: Command run with one JSON argument on unit and batch state changes.

price_table.description: Reserved for cost estimation; the runtime never reports estimated cost as observed cost.
